resources.string: The app stays light. Model files download only after you ask, only when there is enough app-private storage, and may use about 1.25 GB of data. Wi-Fi is recommended.
Package payload: %1$s. Bonsai Q1 base from Prism ML plus the pinned BitAgent v3 adapter from Hugging Face. Both files are checked by exact size and SHA-256.

Downloaded does not mean approved for live use. The current adapter is candidate-only and the repository still marks operator readiness false. It cannot approve, sign, execute, broadcast, access wallet secrets, or change wallet permissions.
Run the official Hermes CLI beside BitAgent on Android. Every command below is fixed in the APK and starts only after you tap it. Interactive Hermes transcripts never return to this app.

Hermes receives a candidate-only BitAgent skill. The bridge does not expose approval, signing, execution, broadcast, seed phrases, private keys, or wallet RPC credentials. Exact wallet approval remains a separate user action.
